value.signature: fn complete_retirement (prepared : & mut Prepared , mut actions : Vec < Action >) -> Result < Value , AdapterFailure >

review.body: { if prepared . controller . state () != State :: Retiring { return selected_completion (actions , & mut prepared . controller) ; } for action in actions . drain (..) { match action { Action :: ReleaseEndpoint => drop (prepared . address . take ()) , Action :: ReleaseBuffers | Action :: ReleaseContext | Action :: ReleasePreparation | Action :: Close | Action :: Cancel { .. } => { } _ => return Err (AdapterFailure :: Configuration) , } } let completed = prepared . controller . advance (Event :: Retired { at : elapsed_ns (prepared . clock) , cleanup_failed : false , }) . map_err (| _ | AdapterFailure :: Configuration) ? ; selected_completion (completed , & mut prepared . controller) }
review.item_premise: This child span records public acquisition, wait or selected outcome inside the adopted binary command; protected address bytes are represented only by the fixed role marker.
